subject: Re: Next steps — Deployment mode & PoC plan (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@delta-enterprises.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — Deployment mode & PoC plan (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Sophie (and team),

Thanks again for the time this morning — good discussion and helpful context on Delta's latency and data residency needs. Per our call, I wanted to capture a short recap and proposed next steps so we can align on an efficient PoC path.

High-level recap
- Objective: validate model quality and integration approach for our customer support automation use case (ticket triage + suggested replies).
- Deployment modes discussed: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput, isolated GPUs), Private VPC / on-prem (required by some regulated flows).
- Primary constraints: security review (data residency and isolation), target p95 latency <= 150ms, sustained throughput ~50 req/s for peak workflows.

Recommended PoC approach (two-track, low friction)
1) Quick Hosted trial (2 weeks):
   - Purpose: validate prompt engineering, quality, and basic integration.
   - Deliverable: sample inference pipeline + evaluation on 1k tickets.
2) Parallel Dedicated sizing & security scoping (4 weeks):
   - Purpose: prove production performance and isolation. We can run a dedicated PoC cluster with representative load (end-to-end).
   - Deliverable: performance report, cost estimate, and a runbook for migration to Private if needed.

Success criteria (for PoC acceptance)
- Model accuracy: intent classification F1 >= 0.88 on the evaluation set.
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms for 512-token context under PoC traffic profile.
- Throughput: sustain 50 req/s with <5% error rate.
- Security: controls documented and SOC2 artifacts provided; confirm data retention & encryption requirements.

Next steps / asks
- Can you confirm the internal stakeholders we should include (infra / security / legal / procurement)?
- Please share the security questionnaire and any specific data residency rules.
- If this approach sounds good, I can circulate a proposed Mutual Action Plan and schedule a 30-min infra sync to scope Dedicated sizing.

Attached: Delta_PoC_Scope.pdf (scope & timeline), SOC2-brief.pdf (high-level compliance summary).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with tentative times for an infra call tomorrow.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Next steps — Deployment mode & PoC plan (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks Ben — that summary is helpful. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Security & residency: our security team is leaning toward Private VPC for any workflows that include PII. We may still be open to a Hosted trial for synthetic / redacted data, but procurement/legal will likely require the Private option for production.
- Stakeholders to loop in: Raj Patel (Infra lead), Mei Chen (Legal), Oscar Gomez (Procurement).
- Timeline: we’re aiming for a Q2 decision but could start a short evaluation window sooner.

I attached the preliminary security questionnaire — happy to fill it out, but Raj will want to review with you directly.

Can you share a rough cost delta between Dedicated and Private for a 4-week PoC? Also please confirm what we should hand over for the Hosted trial (sample data, API keys, expected test traffic).

Best,
Sophie
Head of Product | Delta Enterprises
Sophie.Li@delta-enterprises.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@delta-enterprises.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — Deployment mode & PoC plan (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks Sophie — great, and appreciate the heads up on the security preference. Below are concrete answers and a tightened next-steps list so we can get everyone scheduled.

1) Cost delta (very rough, will provide formal quote after sizing):
   - Hosted trial (2 weeks, evaluation usage): nominal usage costs only — typically the lowest friction and cost up front.
   - Dedicated PoC (4 weeks): one-time reserved capacity for the PoC window; expect higher capex for the reserved GPU pool but more predictable performance.
   - Private VPC / on-prem: adds infra & networking setup (VPN, KMS), and professional services for deployment; usually the highest initial cost and longer lead time.

2) What to provide for Hosted trial (if you want to run it while we scope Dedicated):
   - Sample/anon dataset (1k tickets) or redacted export.
   - Test user flow and acceptance script (we can provide a template).
   - Point of contact for infra (Raj) and data steward.

3) Proposed immediate next steps
   - I’ll schedule a 30-min infra sync next week to scope Dedicated sizing (propose Wed 2027-03-09 10:00-10:30 PT).
   - If agreeable, start a Hosted trial the week of 2027-03-15 (2 weeks) to validate quality.
   - Concurrently, we’ll prepare a Dedicated PoC quote and a Mutual Action Plan for review.

4) PoC success criteria (restated for clarity)
   - Quality: intent F1 >= 0.88 on provided eval set.
   - Perf: p95 <= 150ms, sustain 50 req/s.
   - Security: signed security questionnaire + SOC2 artifacts.

I attached a first draft of a trial plan (trial-plan-v1.pdf) — it has a checklist we can use to drive the mutual action plan. If Raj is available for the infra sync, please add him to the invite and we’ll share a short agenda.

Best,
Ben

----
Attachment stubs:
